title: Agentic Real2Sim: Physics-based World Modeling with Vision-Language Agents
abstract: Real-to-sim conversion for robotic interaction with objects remains labor-intensive because it requires more than visual reconstruction: a streamlined real2sim process must recover scene geometries and object states, infer physical parameters, and assemble actors, objects, cameras, poses, and trajectories into a runnable physical simulation. Today this process still depends on brittle workflow glue across visual perception tools and simulators: manual tuning of visual foundation models, mesh cleanup, coordinate frame alignments, etc. We introduce \textit{Agentic Real2Sim}, a framework for generalized physical world modeling with vision-language agents that converts a real-world recording of object-robot interaction into a simulatable episodic twin, and connects the resulting twin to downstream policy fine-tuning and evaluation. We evaluate Agentic Real2Sim on rigid-object manipulation, deformable-object interaction, and humanoid motion scenes, spanning domains that are usually handled by separate Real2Sim pipelines. The framework's agentic decisions can be driven by an open-weight VLM backend at a small fraction of the cost of frontier models, while attaining a comparable conversion success rate. The framework further supports custom scene conversion, fine-tuning of a pretrained policy with data generated from converted episodes, and works effectively as a surrogate for real-world policy evaluation. The project site, including code is available at https://agentic-real2sim.github.io.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2607.19190v5 的 8 页全文与关键图表核验。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。代码状态：available。
analysis.ideaZh: Agentic Real2Sim 将visual extraction、physical-prior inference、scene prep与grasp sweep组织为episode contract及feedback loops，输出MuJoCo episodic twins。作者在DROID500报告48.4% replay success，349可评估episodes的ADD-S107mm；六task sim-real r=0.920。值得skim系统结构，但best-of最多5×3judge成功规则偏宽松，physical参数未直接验证。
analysis.motivationZh: 把recorded robot interaction转成可执行digital twin需要组织geometry、metric frames、physical priors、camera、robot/object trajectories及sim反馈，现有工具仍需手工glue。
analysis.methodZh: VLM选择物体/关键帧并critic mask/scale/tracking，SAM3/SAM3D/FoundationStereo/FoundationPose供geometry；确定性calibration与base/ground优化后，sim sweep或VLM loop改object placements。3DGS背景与交互foreground depth compositing，统一contract扩展deformable/humanoid adapters，并用episodeaug生成数据和评测policies。
methodFlow: 生成canonical episode meshes/pose tracks/physical priors
analysis.experimentsZh: DROID500随机episodes；100相同episodes比较Gemma431B/Qwen3.635B/GPT5.4/Haiku4.5；PhysTwin-style和G1定性；AIRBOT customcapture；六pick-place task sim-real π0评测。 以下结果为作者报告：作者报告replay48.4%；349evaluable episodes PSNR14.069/SSIM0.650/ADD-S107mm。（Sec.IV.B p.5）；作者报告100case Gemma48success/$2.62，GPT43/$82.30；六task sim-real r=0.920,p=0.009。（Fig.4 p.5; Fig.7/Sec.IV.E p.7） 对照范围：RoboSnap只三scene定性；Gemma一次prompt baseline只3预先成功episodes；backend固定pipeline而非agent组件对照。 消融与诊断：作者明确不做actor-critic ablation；3one-prompt failures无法isolated识别agent贡献；deformable/humanoid仅qualitative。
analysis.insightZh: 贡献是episode-level contract和跨工具simulation alignment，而非新视觉/物理foundation模型；agentic critic设计沿用先前系统，本文没有独立actor-critic消融。
analysis.evidenceZh: 四agent以structured episode artifacts连接visual工具、physics和refinement。（Fig.1 p.1; TableI/Sec.III pp.3–4）；作者报告500episodes里242成功、28partial、230失败。（Sec.IV.B p.5）；replay success采用多个候选/多judge的success finder，未直接校准物理参数。（Sec.IV.A p.4; Limitations p.8）
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 可执行3D scene assets与simulator feedback闭环直接关联视觉设计agent和real2sim资产验证；没有主项目fabrication实验。
analysis.caveatZh: rigid DROID成功率仍低；没有object-level system identification或physical parameters直接验证。；更多deformable和agent/backend可靠性需要systematic evaluation。；max-over-judges/candidates规则宽松，replay可通过placement调整不代表原scene真实；349subset质量指标不能外推所有500。；six-task correlation样本少；modelbill不含全部perception/simulationcompute或人工验证成本。；有工具封装创新但缺agent组件消融；物理参数来自VLM priors不等于测得material。
